t: Unika Mitrebond & 2-Part Adhesive contains a high-viscosity cyanoacrylate glue and a rapid aerosol activator to create instant, high-strength bonds. Ideal for joiners and kitchen fitters working on cornice, pelmet and skirting board joints. The thick, non-drip formula prevents running on vertical surfaces, whilst the activator reduces curing time to just ten seconds. This versatile adhesive dries clear for a clean, professional finish on wood, MDF, metal and plastics, ensuring maximum efficiency with minimal mess.
b: For Bonding Wood, Fibreglass, Metal & Other Materials
